Ran a huge race on debut when fourth, beaten only 1.4 lengths at Hawkesbury over 1100m after racing wide without cover throughout. Adds blinkers second-up and maps for an ideal stalking run in style P. Sets the benchmark here. | ⚠️ Wide

selections.name: Artfull
selections.reason: Gains significant tactical dominance from the rails draw as post-scratch lone speed. Score boosted by Lone Speed (+6) bonus. Resumes from a 5-month spell following an impressive Gosford trial win. Has the early speed to control tempo from the front in style E on Soft 5 going under Ashley Morgan. | 🔥 Lone Speed

selections.name: Alabama Showdown
selections.reason: Solid Warwick Farm shipper from the Joseph Pride stable. Finished runner-up first-up at Wyong over 1000m and previously placed third in heavy ground at Kembla Grange. Effective weight of 59.0kg is manageable at 1100m, but his swooping style S may give the leaders too much leeway around the bend.

selections.name: Spokesperson
selections.reason: Debutant from the Matthew Smith stable at Warwick Farm. Has prepped with three metropolitan barrier trials, most recently finishing third over 800m. Half-brother to Listed stakes winner The Black Cloud. Receives weight relief carrying 56.5kg and maps to track handy in style P.

selections.name: Rapid Reigns
selections.reason: First starter by Wootton Bassett for Annabel and Rob Archibald. Has had four barrier trials to build fitness, but trial margins have been plain and he typically settles off the speed in style S. Stable demands respect, but minor money looks his ceiling on debut.

contenders.handicapper_notes: Dominant 4.8-length debut winner over this course and distance clocking a swift 1:04.2 with an outstanding 71 speed rating. Drawn ideally in barrier 2 for Matthew Dale and Keagan Latham. Canonical style P allows him to sit right behind the lone speed before pouncing down the 400m home straight. Rates as a clear Solo Lock.

Score boosted due to Post-Scratch Lone Speed (+6) following the scratching of The Glen. Returns from a five-month spell with sharp trials and gets 3kg apprentice relief down to 55kg. Canonical style E allows her to dictate the tempo without early pace pressure.

Local Danny Williams trainee dropping back from 1300m after a closing third beaten just a neck in Class 1 company here. Drawn low in gate 1 with Adrian Layt aboard. Canonical style S will be doing his best work late down the expansive Goulburn fairway.

Designated Danger Horse. Brings proven wet-track consistency with consecutive Class 1 placings, including an eye-catching third at Gundagai on heavy ground after covering extra ground throughout. Canonical style P gives her every opportunity to fill the frame.

First-up from a five-month break for Scott Collings with Alysha Collett booked. Maintains a perfect place record at Goulburn (3: 0-2-1), but the sharp drop from route trips back to 1100m may leave her lacking the turn of foot required to threaten the top pick. Canonical style P.

Finished fifth behind Wolf Island and Glenn's Legacy here last start over 1300m. Prior placing at Sapphire Coast over 1000m on soft ground confirms track condition suitability, but looks held by the leading contenders. Canonical style P.
